title: GTA6 Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Are Now Available for Preorder
description: Preorders for the Grand Theft Auto VI Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers are officially live, but stock is extremely limited. Act fast!
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Available for Preorder

The anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to drive excitement across the gaming community, and now fans have a chance to grab a piece of official hardware. According to a recent report by IGN Games, preorders for the *Grand Theft Auto VI* Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers are officially live.

For PlayStation 5 owners and dedicated fans of the franchise, themed controllers offer a great way to showcase their enthusiasm while waiting for the game. However, securing one might prove to be a challenge.

## Act Fast: Stock is Extremely Limited

As noted by IGN Games, the stock for these limited-edition controllers is **very limited**. Given the massive global appeal of the GTA series, high-profile hardware collaborations of this nature historically tend to sell out within minutes of going live.

* **Availability Warning**: Retailers have not disclosed exact production numbers, but with supplies tightly constrained, hesitation will likely result in missing out.
* **Collector's Appeal**: For enthusiasts looking to collect memorabilia tied to the launch of GTA6, acquiring official limited-edition hardware at retail price is always a priority.

## Editor's Take

Limited-edition controllers are always a hot commodity, and anything associated with GTA6 is guaranteed to vanish from shelves instantly. If you want to secure one of these controllers without turning to scalpers, your best bet is to check the live preorders immediately and act fast before supplies dry up completely.
